**Yes—SMEs already employing AI specialists were more likely to seek additional AI staff than other SMEs**, according to the 2023 *Drivers of AI investment* study. Large companies showed the opposite pattern: those with existing AI staff were less likely to hire more than other large companies.[1]

The authors interpreted the SME pattern as suggesting increased AI specialisation among AI-based SMEs.[2]

The finding concerns **recruitment activity, not confirmed hires**: the study compared LinkedIn job advertisements and employee skills profiles, with job-ad searches conducted in August and September 2022.[3] The authors also cautioned that employee data could be incomplete, potentially missing existing AI skills, particularly in larger companies.[4]

citations.quote: Further, SMEs with existing AI-staff are more likely to hire more AI-staff than other SMEs. Conversely, large companies with existing AI-staff are less likely to hire additional AI-staff than other large companies (model 9).
